text: Our question answering system uses a BGE encoder to represent passages and questions as dense vectors. A FAISS index retrieves the five most similar passages.
The experiment compares dense retrieval with a lexical baseline. Retrieval latency and answer quality are measured separately. No actual numerical results are reported in this synthetic example.
The image classification model is a convolutional neural network trained on labeled photographs. The classifier predicts an object category for each image.
